description:
## City Secondary School Ssenge - School Nurse

**City Secondary School Ssenge** is a secondary school located in **Ssenge, Wakiso District**, committed to providing a safe and healthy learning environment for all students. The school is looking for a qualified and caring **School Nurse** to manage the sick bay and provide healthcare services to students and staff.

## About the Role

The School Nurse will be responsible for running and managing the school sick bay, providing first aid, health education and basic healthcare to students and staff. This is a hands-on role that requires a compassionate and organised nursing professional who can work independently in a school setting.

## Key Responsibilities

- Manage the school sick bay, ensuring it is clean, well-stocked and ready to handle daily health needs
- Provide first aid and basic medical care to students and staff who fall ill or get injured during school hours
- Assess and triage students presenting with symptoms and determine whether they need further medical attention
- Administer prescribed medications to students and maintain accurate medication records
- Monitor students with chronic conditions such as asthma, allergies, diabetes and epilepsy
- Maintain health records for all students, including immunisation records and medical history
- Carry out routine health checks and screenings as required by the school or Ministry of Health guidelines
- Educate students on personal hygiene, nutrition, reproductive health and disease prevention
- Respond to medical emergencies and coordinate referrals to nearby hospitals or clinics when necessary
- Communicate with parents or guardians about their child's health concerns and medical needs
- Coordinate with school administration on health-related policies, outbreak prevention and sanitation standards
- Ensure the sick bay is properly stocked with essential medicines, first aid supplies and equipment
- Prepare health reports and statistics for the school administration and Ministry of Education
- Implement infection prevention and control measures within the school environment

## Requirements

- **Certificate in Nursing** or equivalent qualification from a recognised institution
- Must be registered with the Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC)
- Valid practising licence
- Experience working as a school nurse or in a similar healthcare role is an added advantage
- Knowledge of first aid, basic healthcare and common childhood illnesses
- Good communication and interpersonal skills, especially when dealing with young people
- Ability to work independently and manage the sick bay with minimal supervision
- Compassionate, patient and approachable manner
- Strong organisational and record-keeping skills

## What We Offer

- Salary of **300,000 UGX per month**
- **Meals and accommodation provided**
- A supportive and friendly school environment
- Opportunity to make a real difference in the health and wellbeing of students

## How to Apply

Send your CV via **WhatsApp** to:

📱 **0783 365 557**

> **Important:** No phone calls will be accepted. Applications via WhatsApp only.

## Deadline

Applications are open until the position is filled.
